title: Why Is the Sky Blue?
narration: Sunlight is made of many colors mixed together.
Tiny bits of air scatter the blue light more than the other colors — so blue fills the sky we see.
At sunset, the light travels farther… and warmer colors win the show.
description:
Why is the sky blue? Kid-safe Blender 3D science short (ages 6–10).
